name: Magh Bihu
description: Assamese harvest festival marking end of harvesting season — bonfires (Meji) and feasting

name: Bohag Bihu (Rongali Bihu)
description: Assamese New Year and spring festival — the most joyous Bihu celebrated with dance and songs

name: Baisagu
description: Bodo tribe spring festival coinciding with Bohag Bihu

name: Ambubachi Mela
description: Annual festival at Kamakhya Temple — thousands of pilgrims gather when Goddess Kamakhya menstruates

name: Kati Bihu
description: Assamese lighting festival — lamps lit in fields and homes to protect crops

name: Ali Ai Ligang
description: Mising tribe spring sowing festival — celebrated in Assam's Mising community
